thread:
sam: Hey team, I'm filing a small docs PR to straighten out the prefetch + batch example flow under /optimize/toolkit. The existing page has two parallel examples which confuse readers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502 :memo:
leigh: Thanks. Can you also add a short "How this affects latency" blurb? People expect prefetch to always help but it can increase tail latency for tiny requests.
marta: Also flag the compatibility bit: `prefetch: true` depends on the model serving a prefetch manifest (we should link the model catalog note). Had a customer use `llama-2-legacy` and got a 500.
sam: Good — I'll link the model-catalog note and add an inline troubleshooting bullet.
leigh: For code examples, I'd prefer a compact JS streaming example and then a one-liner curl so SDK + non-SDK users are covered.
sam: Draft JS streaming snippet (keeps minimal fields):
```js
// JS promise-based stream
const stream = await client.streamGenerate({
  model: 'alder-prefetch-1',
  input: 'Explain zeroshot intent',
  prefetch: true,
  batch: { size: 4, max_concurrent_requests: 2 }
});
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```
leigh: Sweet. Add a parenthetical explaining `max_concurrent_requests` prevents too many inflight micro-batches (common gotcha).
marta: One more: show recommended quant profile mapping for typical short vs long seq workloads. Keep it prescriptive but not absolute. I suggest a tiny two-row example: short -> `q8_0`, medium -> `q6_0`, long -> `q4_k_m`.
sam: Adding that as a small table and an admonition: "profile choices trade off quality vs memory and throughput".
ci-bot: build/docs-md-lint: failed 1 lines exceed max length (optimize/toolkit.md).
sam: Fixing wraps now. Will push a new commit.
ci-bot: build/docs-md-lint: passed on branch sam/clarify-prefetch.
deploy-bot: sample-evals/fast-examples: started (runs example snippets through harness).
leigh: Nice. Can we also add a micro-test under tests/examples/test_prefetch_cli.py that runs the curl one-liner? Keeps CI honest.
sam: Good idea. I'll add a tiny pytest that shells out and checks 200.
ci-bot: sample-evals/fast-examples: passed.
marta: Quick editorial nit: use `batch.size` in prose to match other docs (not `batch: { size }`).
sam: Updated phrasing and pushed.
leigh: After merge please drop a one-paragraph entry in #release-notes and link the PR. Ops likes a changelog line for doc changes that affect customers.
sam: Will do on merge. Thanks all. Merge once CI green. :white_check_mark:
